title: The Ancient stone wall
subtitle: 文化遗产 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）
meta: 主题语境：文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）　|　核心词汇：ancient　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ancient 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the doctor wrote of ① an ancient stone wall in the chart, and everybody in the clinic said at once that it was ② more ancient than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the doctor, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the ancient ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most ancient stone wall anybody in the clinic had ever seen, or so the chart for January 1948 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too ancient to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the patient who had come to help; the ancient ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an ancient custom of the village, and said that no patient in his right mind would call it ⑥ as ancient as the custom of the village they had once had in the old clinic. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was ancient or not, and he said so.

By 1961 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the chart. What the line asked for was ⑦ something ancient, and nothing besides. The patient from the next clinic called the whole plan ⑧ quite ancient; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the chart kept the names of the ancient ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1964, on the same day, she wrote of another ancient stone wall in the same chart, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more ancient than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most ancient custom of the village in the whole clinic, she said in 1966, was the one she could never quite name; the ancient ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 古老（前置定语 an ancient stone wall：1954 年大夫在病历里记下的那件古老的石墙）
B. adj. 古老／年代久远（比较级 more ancient than：文中两处，一处比石墙，一处比预想）
C. adj. 古老／年代久远（最高级 the most ancient：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 古老（表语 too ancient to do：母亲觉得它太古老，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 年代久远（前置定语 an ancient custom of the village：叔叔把整件事称作一桩年代久远的旧俗）
F. adj. 年代久远（同级比较 as ancient as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩村里的旧俗相比）
G. adj. 年代久远（后置定语 something ancient：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 年代久远（受程度副词修饰 quite ancient：那位病人的评价）

items.q: the most ancient stone wall anybody
an ancient custom of the village
The most ancient custom of the village in

answers.why: ancient 意为“古老”，1954 年大夫在病历里记下的是“一件古老的石墙”，此处作前置定语 an ancient stone wall。
ancient 意为“古老”，此处用比较级 more ancient than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
ancient 意为“古老”，病历上 一月 那行字说它是卫生所里最古老的一件，故用最高级 the most ancient stone wall。
ancient 意为“古老”，母亲认为这件东西“太古老了，谁也用不上”，too ancient to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
ancient 意为“年代久远”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩年代久远的旧俗”，此处作前置定语 an ancient custom of the village。
ancient 意为“年代久远”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩村里的旧俗一样年代久远”，同级比较用 as ancient as。
ancient 意为“年代久远”，病历上那半行字要的是“年代久远的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something ancient。
ancient 意为“年代久远”，邻卫生所来的那位病人认为这套计划“相当年代久远”，quite 修饰原级 ancient。
ancient 意为“年代久远”，1964 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要年代久远”，故用比较级 more ancient than。
ancient 意为“年代久远”，母亲 1966 年说的是“整个卫生所里最年代久远的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most ancient custom of the village。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年，大夫在病历里记下了一件古老的石墙。（an ancient stone wall）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更古老。（more ancient than …）
母亲觉得它太古老，谁也用不上。（too ancient to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩年代久远的旧俗。（an ancient custom of the village）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩村里的旧俗一样年代久远。（as ancient as …）
到了 1961 年，病历上只剩半行字：要的是一件年代久远的东西。（something ancient）
answers: In 1954 the doctor wrote of an ancient stone wall in the chart.
Everybody said it was more ancient than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too ancient to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an ancient custom of the village.
He said nobody would call it as ancient as the custom of the village they had once had.
By 1961 the chart asked for nothing but something ancient.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 ancient 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1954 the doctor wrote of an ancient stone wall in the chart, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most ancient stone wall in the clinic, or so the chart says.
My mother thought it too ancient to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an ancient custom of the village, and nobody argued with him.
The patient from the next clinic called the plan quite ancient, and everybody laughed.
The ancient ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
